title: I don’t even consider this a blanket.
text: I don’t even consider this a blanket.. I am very disappointed. I read the reviews, and it seemed that this is what I was looking for. Well, it wasn’t! I wouldn’t even consider this a blanket. It doesn’t have anything soft or cozy about it. It’s like a big piece of fabric.  I had a fabric shower curtain in this pattern once, and it is the first thing I thought of when I felt this “blanket. It is just like a fabric shower curtain. It also maybe could be used as a coverlet for the bed?? Idk! All I know is this is not a blanket to me. I am returning it.
